scenarios.name: Five simultaneous missions
scenarios.operations_performed: Create & execute 5 distinct multi-step missions simultaneously via Promise.all.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: All 5 reach COMPLETED with unique IDs, verified memory rows, zero cross-contamination.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: 5/5 completed; isolated memories=5/5

scenarios.name: Ten simultaneous missions
scenarios.operations_performed: Create & execute 10 concurrent missions simultaneously via MissionControlService.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: All 10 reach COMPLETED with 0 SQLITE_CONSTRAINT or lost state errors.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: 10/10 simultaneous missions completed cleanly.

scenarios.name: Missions with shared DAG dependencies
scenarios.operations_performed: Execute diamond DAG mission: Step 1 -> Step 2 (dep [1]), Step 3 (dep [1]) -> Step 4 (dep [2,3]).
scenarios.expected_postconditions: Step 4 completed_at >= max(Step 2, Step 3) >= Step 1.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Mission COMPLETED; DAG timestamps monotonically ordered: true

scenarios.name: Conflicting file access via atomic writes
scenarios.operations_performed: Fire 8 concurrent atomic write-rename operations to same target file in disposable workspace.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: Zero torn/corrupted intermediate reads; final file matches one complete valid payload.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: 8 concurrent file writers finished; zero torn reads (true); valid intact final content (PAYLOAD_COMPLETE_7_XXX)

scenarios.name: Concurrent approval requests
scenarios.operations_performed: Start 3 missions requiring approval for sensitive delete_memory; approve 2, leave 1 pending.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: Approved 2 complete cleanly; unapproved 1 stays WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL without premature deletion.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: All 3 paused at WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL; 2 approved & deleted memories; Mission 3 stayed WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL & mem-c05-3 preserved.

scenarios.name: Mission cancellation during execution
scenarios.operations_performed: Launch 3-step mission; invoke cancelMission() immediately while step loop progresses.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: Mission status transitions to CANCELLED and never marks COMPLETED.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Mission status locked to CANCELLED after mid-flight cancellation.

scenarios.name: Worker saturation bounded queue
scenarios.operations_performed: With MISSION_MAX_WORKERS=4, start 8 missions concurrently and audit worker pool ceiling.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: peak_active_workers <= 4, queue engages cleanly, all 8 complete.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Peak active workers: 4/4, peak queue: 4; 8/8 completed.

scenarios.name: Duplicate mission submission prevention
scenarios.operations_performed: Call createMission({ objective, idempotencyKey: "dup-key-s3" }) twice sequentially/concurrently.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: Second call returns deduplicated=true with same mission ID; DB row count for key == 1.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Mission1 ID=mission-1795588703258-ki3vp, Mission2 ID=mission-1795588703258-ki3vp (deduplicated=true), DB count=1

scenarios.name: Priority scheduling order verification
scenarios.operations_performed: Saturate 4 worker slots, enqueue Priority 1 (LOW) then Priority 4 (CRITICAL), inspect dispatch_history.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: Priority 4 mission is dequeued and dispatched BEFORE Priority 1 mission.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Dispatch order: CRITICAL idx=4, LOW idx=5 (critical first: true)

scenarios.name: Recovery of partially completed concurrent missions
scenarios.operations_performed: Seed 3 RUNNING concurrent missions with Step 1 pre-verified in DB & Step 2 PENDING; run recoverInterruptedMissions().
scenarios.expected_postconditions: All 3 missions auto-resume, preserve Step 1 VERIFIED without duplication, and finish Step 2 -> COMPLETED.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Recovered 3 missions; 3/3 completed Step 1 pre-verified + Step 2 executed.

scenarios.name: Kill active worker & watchdog respawn
scenarios.operations_performed: Spawn real Node.js child worker process, kill PID1 via SIGTERM, respawn replacement PID2.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: PID1 exits; replacement PID2 starts with distinct PID and alive heartbeat.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Terminated worker PID 19384; respawned healthy worker PID 19900 in 1074ms.

scenarios.name: Terminate backend during active mission execution
scenarios.operations_performed: Run isolated supervisor.js on port 5056; seed RUNNING mission + Step 1 pending; SIGKILL backend; assert supervisor respawn & mission completion.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: Supervisor respawns backend with new PID; interrupted mission restores & reaches COMPLETED.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Killed backend PID 21924 -> respawned PID 25472 (4648ms); mission=COMPLETED, memory=SURVIVED

scenarios.name: Restart backend during endurance checkpoint persistence
scenarios.operations_performed: Start endurance loop on supervised backend port 5057; let sample & checkpoint persist; kill backend; verify respawned backend resumes timers cleanly.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: Respawned backend preserves sample count, resumes endurance_timers_active=true, logs SERVER_RESTART_RESUMED.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Old PID 12752 -> New PID 2496 (5744ms); timers_active=true, samples=1, SERVER_RESTART_RESUMED=true

scenarios.name: Terminate Python agent during automation task
scenarios.operations_performed: Spawn Python agent; invoke telemetry task; kill Python PID mid-session; verify Node fallback + UNEXPECTED_OFFLINE_FALLBACK + respawn.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: First telemetry succeeds live; after Python kill, Node fallback returns safe metrics & flags UNEXPECTED_OFFLINE_FALLBACK; respawn restores ONLINE.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Live OK (PID 22628) -> Killed -> Fallback engaged (UNEXPECTED_OFFLINE_FALLBACK) -> Respawned PID 24508 ONLINE (2499ms).

scenarios.name: Interrupt and recover scheduler
scenarios.operations_performed: Stop SchedulerService, insert overdue reminder in DB, restart scheduler and run tick().
scenarios.expected_postconditions: Interrupted scheduler catches overdue reminder upon restart, marks triggered, and logs notification.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Scheduler stopped -> overdue reminder persisted -> restarted & tick() triggered reminder (triggered) in 5ms.

scenarios.name: Restart multiple workers simultaneously
scenarios.operations_performed: Spawn 3 concurrent worker processes, kill all 3 simultaneously, respawn 3 replacements and verify IPC health.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: All 3 workers cleanly replaced with 3 new unique PIDs.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Killed 3 workers [26432,18144,18656] -> simultaneously respawned [13812,14076,11476] in 1501ms.

scenarios.name: Concurrent SQLite reads and writes
scenarios.operations_performed: Execute 50 concurrent SELECT queries alongside 30 concurrent INSERT memory writes under WAL mode.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: All 80 operations succeed with 0 errors and all 30 writes persisted.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: 80 concurrent ops finished; 30/30 rows persisted; integrity=ok.

scenarios.name: Multiple BEGIN IMMEDIATE lock contenders
scenarios.operations_performed: Open 3 independent SQLite connections (busy_timeout=5000); run 3 simultaneous BEGIN IMMEDIATE write transactions.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: WAL busy_timeout arbitrates contention so all 3 transactions serialize and commit cleanly.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: 3 concurrent BEGIN IMMEDIATE contenders committed 3/3 rows without lock drops.

scenarios.name: Busy timeout exhaustion handling
scenarios.operations_performed: Conn A holds BEGIN IMMEDIATE lock for 500ms; Conn B with busy_timeout=50ms attempts write -> hits SQLITE_BUSY cleanly, then retries after unlock.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: Conn B catches real SQLITE_BUSY cleanly without crashing, preserves DB integrity, succeeds on retry.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Caught real SQLITE_BUSY (true) after 50ms exhaustion; post-unlock retry succeeded (true).

scenarios.name: Transaction rollback atomicity
scenarios.operations_performed: Execute BEGIN -> INSERT canary memory -> ROLLBACK on dedicated connection.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: Canary row count == 0 after ROLLBACK.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Rollback atomicity preserved; canary row present = false.

scenarios.name: Interrupted writes recovery
scenarios.operations_performed: Simulate uncommitted SQLite write before forced connection close + atomic file write temp cleanup check.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: Uncommitted row is absent from DB; atomic file write leaves zero partial artifacts.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Uncommitted dirty row absent=true; atomic file write verified=true.

scenarios.name: WAL growth and TRUNCATE checkpointing
scenarios.operations_performed: Write 150 rows to grow WAL log, then execute PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE).
scenarios.expected_postconditions: WAL file truncates cleanly; PRAGMA integrity_check remains ok.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: WAL size 4124152B -> 0B after TRUNCATE checkpoint; integrity=ok.

scenarios.name: Concurrent mission state transitions & telemetry reconciliation
scenarios.operations_performed: Transition 10 missions concurrently PENDING->RUNNING->COMPLETED; reconcile DB counts vs telemetry sample.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: DB counts match telemetry snapshot 100%.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Telemetry observed active=10 during transitions, reconciled to 0 (DB=0) after.

scenarios.name: DNS resolution failure handling
scenarios.operations_performed: Perform real dns.lookup("nonexistent.invalid.local") and pass caught error into BaseProvider.classifyError().
scenarios.expected_postconditions: ENOTFOUND caught without crash, classified as retryable NETWORK_TIMEOUT, zero false success.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: DNS failure (ENOTFOUND) cleanly classified as NETWORK_TIMEOUT (retryable=true).

scenarios.name: Connection timeout enforcement
scenarios.operations_performed: Start local blackhole HTTP server delaying 1200ms; request via axios with timeout=200ms; classify error.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: Axios aborts at ~200ms with ECONNABORTED; classified as NETWORK_TIMEOUT.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Bounded timeout enforced in 223ms (ECONNABORTED); classified NETWORK_TIMEOUT.

classified.message: Network connection failed or timed out

scenarios.name: HTTP 429 rate limit backoff & recovery
scenarios.operations_performed: Mock HTTP server returns 429 twice then 200 OK on 3rd attempt; execute bounded exponential backoff retry loop.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: Two 429s classified RATE_LIMIT (retryable=true); 3rd attempt succeeds.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Handled 2x HTTP 429 RATE_LIMIT with backoff; 3rd request returned 200 OK.

scenarios.name: HTTP 503 unavailability handling
scenarios.operations_performed: Mock HTTP server returns 503 Service Unavailable; verify BaseProvider classification & backoff.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: Classified as MODEL_UNAVAILABLE with retryable=true; never treated as success.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: HTTP 503 accurately classified MODEL_UNAVAILABLE (status=503, retryable=true).

scenarios.name: Provider unavailability graceful failure
scenarios.operations_performed: Attempt request to closed local port (ECONNREFUSED) and run ModelRouterService unconfigured check.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: ECONNREFUSED classified NETWORK_TIMEOUT (retryable=true); zero crash.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Unreachable endpoint (ECONNREFUSED) classified cleanly as NETWORK_TIMEOUT.

classified.message: Network connection failed or timed out

scenarios.name: Reconnection after network restoration
scenarios.operations_performed: Toggle mock endpoint from 503 outage to 200 OK restored; verify immediate recovery.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: Fails cleanly during outage, succeeds immediately upon restoration.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Failed during 503 outage -> reconnected seamlessly on restoration in 2ms.

scenarios.name: Retry exhaustion bounded halt
scenarios.operations_performed: Execute bounded retry loop (maxRetries=2 -> max 3 attempts) against persistent 503 endpoint.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: Stops after exactly 3 attempts and surfaces failure (no infinite retries, no false success).
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Bounded retry exhausted after exactly 3 attempts (1 initial + 2 retries); error propagated accurately.

scenarios.name: Multi-provider fallback check
scenarios.operations_performed: Inspect ModelRouterService.getProvidersStatus() for configured real providers and evaluate fallback chain.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: If >=2 real providers configured, test real failover -> PASS; if <2 configured, report PARTIALLY_VERIFIED/NOT_TESTED honestly.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Only 0 real external providers configured (none) on this host; cannot run live multi-key cloud failover (honestly classified PARTIALLY_VERIFIED). ModelRouter fallback exhaustion & priority chain (groq->openrouter->ollama->gemini->mistral) verified.

scenarios.name: Ten concurrent duplicate execution attempts
scenarios.operations_performed: Invoke startMission(sameId) 10 times concurrently via Promise.all on a single mission.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: Re-entrancy lock allows 1 execution, deduplicates 9, writes memory key ONCE.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: 9/10 concurrent calls deduplicated via execution lock; DB memory count = 1.

scenarios.name: Invalid tool arguments rejection
scenarios.operations_performed: Call ToolRegistry.executeTool() with missing required params & wrong numeric type.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: Schema validation rejects calls before handler executes, returning success=false.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: All 3 invalid argument payloads blocked cleanly prior to execution.

scenarios.name: Missing resources & unknown tools handling
scenarios.operations_performed: Execute nonexistent tool and read_file on missing file.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: Returns clean { success: false }, zero crash, zero false completion.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Unknown tool & missing file both returned clean failures without crashes.

rUnknown.error: Tool 'nonexistent_magic_tool' is not recognized in the NOVA tool registry.

scenarios.name: Dynamic replanning during execution
scenarios.operations_performed: Seed mission with failing write_file (Python offline); run startMission -> triggers replanMissionDAG -> get_system_telemetry fallback.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: replan_count increments to 1, step replanned safely, mission reaches COMPLETED.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Mission dynamically replanned (replan_count=1) and reached COMPLETED.

scenarios.name: Infinite replanning loop prevention
scenarios.operations_performed: Seed mission with replan_count=2 and failing primary step (read_file on missing target when Python offline -> fails again).
scenarios.expected_postconditions: replanMissionDAG enforces max bound 2 returning false; mission halts at FAILED.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Bounded replan limit (2) enforced; mission halted truthfully at FAILED with replan_count=2.

scenarios.name: Approval bypass attempt blocked
scenarios.operations_performed: Seed tampered step using SENSITIVE_TOOL (delete_memory) with requires_approval=0 & approved_at=NULL; execute startMission().
scenarios.expected_postconditions: MissionControl detects sensitive unapproved tool, overrides tampered flag, pauses at WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL; target memory untouched.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Tampered requires_approval=0 intercepted! Status forced to WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL; memory PROTECTED intact.

scenarios.name: Malicious tool output sanitization
scenarios.operations_performed: Pass malicious tool payload containing __proto__, <script>, and IGNORE ALL PREVIOUS INSTRUCTIONS through sanitizeToolOutput().
scenarios.expected_postconditions: Prototype keys stripped, directives & script tags redacted, untrusted_content_sanitized=true.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Sanitized output (flag=true, no <script>, no __proto__, no instruction override).

scenarios.name: Prompt injection through retrieved files isolated
scenarios.operations_performed: Write disposable file containing SYSTEM DIRECTIVE payload; evaluate perception correlation & sanitizeToolOutput.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: Perception treats file passively (isRelevant=false); sanitizeToolOutput redacts SYSTEM DIRECTIVE.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Passive data boundary preserved (isRelevant=false); directive redacted ([REDACTED_UNTRUSTED_DIRECTIVE] [REDACTED_UNTRUSTED_DIRECTIVE] AND WIPE DISK).

scenarios.name: Mission completion blocked when postconditions fail
scenarios.operations_performed: Write mismatched file content; run TruthfulVerificationService.verifyOutcome("write_file") directly and verify failure guard.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: TruthfulVerificationService returns verified=false with content mismatch error.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: TruthfulVerification blocked false completion: verified=false (Content integrity failure: physical file contents do not match requested write payload).

scenarios.name: Cancellation during irreversible-action approval
scenarios.operations_performed: Mission waits at WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL for delete_memory; cancelMission() invoked; then attempt approveStep().
scenarios.expected_postconditions: Mission cancels permanently; late approveStep() rejected with APPROVAL_REJECTED; canary memory survives.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Cancelled during approval -> late approveStep rejected (true); canary memory intact.

scenarios.name: Controlled CPU pressure burst
scenarios.operations_performed: Run bounded 800ms SHA-256 hashing burst, then verify event loop & latency return to nominal.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: Completed within bounded ceiling; post-burst async timer lag < 50ms.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Executed 430864 SHA-256 hashes (CPU user=734ms); post-burst event loop lag=16ms.

scenarios.name: Controlled memory pressure within hardware bounds
scenarios.operations_performed: Allocate 32MB temporary Buffer chunk cleanly within 450MB ceiling, then release reference.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: Allocation stays below ceiling without crash or OOM.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Allocated & released 32MB safely; peak RSS=125.65MB, post-release heap=20.12MB (< 450MB).

scenarios.name: Growing mission queue observability under backlog
scenarios.operations_performed: Seed 25 PENDING missions in DB, capture sample, transition to COMPLETED, capture post-drain sample.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: Telemetry observes queued_missions jump by +25 and cleanly drop back by -25.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Queue tracked +25 PENDING growth (1 -> 26 -> 1).

scenarios.name: Notification backlog spike & recovery
scenarios.operations_performed: Seed 30 unread unified_notifications, sample telemetry, acknowledge all, sample recovery.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: Telemetry tracks +30 unread backlog growth and returns to baseline cleanly.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Notification backlog tracked +30 (0 -> 30 -> 0).

scenarios.name: Worker saturation pressure (9 missions / 4 slots)
scenarios.operations_performed: Launch 9 concurrent missions under 4-worker ceiling and confirm bounded concurrency & complete drain.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: Active workers capped <= 4; queue absorbs overflow; 9/9 complete.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Peak active=4/4, peak queue=5; drained active=0; 9/9 completed.

scenarios.name: System recovery after all pressure removed
scenarios.operations_performed: Sample post-stress DB integrity, heap bounds, scheduler active state, and fast query latency.
scenarios.expected_postconditions: SQLite integrity=ok, scheduler alive, query < 50ms, heap well below ceiling.
scenarios.observed_postconditions: Post-stress DB integrity=ok (2ms), heap=21.76MB, scheduler active=true.
